takes.take: Messi is the GOAT. No debate needed.
Guardiola's 2009–12 side is the best club team ever.
Lamine Yamal will win a Ballon d'Or before he turns 22.
The 6–1 Remontada is the greatest match in football history.

opinions.opinion: The greatest of all time. His vision, dribbling, passing and consistency over 15+ years make him untouchable. Eight Ballon d'Ors speak for themselves.
Incredible athlete and goal scorer, but Messi's all-round game is on another level.
Messi is the reason I started watching Barça, but the style is why I stayed. More than a club: La Masia, and the tiki-taka era under Guardiola. He left, the support didn't.
Respect their Champions League pedigree, but Barcelona's football philosophy is superior.
The greatest rivalry in football. Always a special day, always rooting for Barça.
Generational talent. The scary part is how young he still is.
My favourite player at Barça right now. The control and the vision are ridiculous; he reminds me of Iniesta.
Great competition and entertainment, but La Liga has produced better technical players historically.
Finally. Messi deserved it, and Argentina's win was the perfect ending to his international story.
Barcelona need to rebuild and get back to winning it. The 2015 treble team was special.
His skill videos are what got me into football in the first place, so I'll always have a soft spot. Ridiculous talent.

moments.title: 6–1 vs PSG
moments.why: The greatest comeback in Champions League history. I still get goosebumps thinking about Sergi Roberto's winner.

since: I started watching in 2018, through Neymar skill compilations. Then I found Messi, and that was that. I've gone back and filled in the history since the late 2000s.
